caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic cup with a handle, centered within a lightly sketched square frame. The cup is rendered in shades of gray, with shading that suggests a smooth, reflective surface and subtle highlights, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. Above the cup, near the upper left corner of the square frame, there is a rectangular label that contains cursive handwriting, reading "L. Morere to S.E. Ward." Below the square frame, near the bottom left, the name "EUGENIE LA FORET." is written in capital letters. The background of the entire drawing is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or decorative elements.
title: Silver Cup
